messages:
morgan: Heads-up — customer asks if we can prove key custody boundaries for BYOK when Dedicated uses cross-region failover. Need short summary for legal + SOC2 auditor.

sasha: @morgan can you share the exact question from the customer? Is it around where plaintext ever exists or who has rewrap privileges?

morgan: They want: 1) which components can see unencrypted model inputs/outputs, 2) who can trigger a rewrap or import, 3) audit trail we keep for those actions.

diego: Short answer: plaintext never leaves the serving nodes; BYOK material is only in customer HSM/KMS. But we do have rewrap keys in our KMS when customer opts for escrow/fallback.

priya: Important nuance: for Dedicated w/ cross-region failover we copy encrypted key blobs between regions. Rewrap path kicks in only if customer-enabled fallback is configured. That has different compliance implications.

morgan: Can we get an internal diagram we can send? auditor will want who/what/principals.

oncall: We should also include the RBAC change history and last time operator entitlements were updated. Auditor likes "who had access when".

kms-bot: Reminder: last rewrap operation executed 2024-11-05T03:21:18Z by service-account:dedicated-escrow (audit id: ab12-ef34).

sasha: Action plan proposal: 1) produce custody boundary doc (one page), 2) export RBAC audit for last 24 months, 3) export KMS/HSM audit events (imports, rewraps, key-policy changes) in CSV, 4) call w/ auditor next week. Agree?

priya: +1. Also call out SLOs that trigger failover (so they know when cross-region copy can happen). Put those as bullet points.

diego: For RBAC export, we need a mapping: human operators vs service accounts vs oncall ephemeral tokens. We should redact internal emails.

morgan: I'll draft the custody boundary page. Can someone run the audit queries and attach an example CSV of a rewrap event? Preferably include the raw audit JSON snippet (redacted).

sasha: I'll run the RBAC export (IAM change log) and scrub PII. ETA EOD.

priya: I'll pull the KMS/HSM events. Note: HSM vendor logs require the shim translation — working with infra to decode. Might take 24–48h.

diego: For the rewrap example, use this redacted snippet: ```{ "event":"RewrapKey", "time":"2024-11-05T03:21:18Z", "actor":"service-account:dedicated-escrow", "key_id":"redacted", "action":"rewrap", "region":"us-west-2" }```

morgan: Good. Two compliance questions we should pre-empt: 1) retention of audit logs (customer expects 7 years for some regs), 2) evidence we don't have plaintext. Any quick text we can copy into the doc?

priya: Logs retention: hosted mode retention is 90 days by default, enterprise/Private can configure retention and export to customer's log sink. Call out S3 export + checksum.

sasha: Plaintext: include sentence — "All cryptographic operations involving unwrapped customer keys are performed on isolated serving nodes; key material is never persisted in plaintext on disk or transmitted to third-party services." (ops/infra reviewed).

oncall: Also add incident response steps: if a rewrap is observed outside scheduled maintenance, automatic alert to oncall + freeze on new writes and immediate tabletop. We have a runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/byok-incident

morgan: Nice. One more — auditor will ask about authorization model for emergency break-glass. We need a short bullet: who can authorize a break-glass, evidence trail, and that entitlements are MFA-protected.

diego: Break-glass: requires 2-person approval from Security leads + SOC exec, logged in KMS policy change events, and pre-staged temporary creds that expire in 1 hour. Add that to doc.

priya: I'll include the hashchain evidence we attach to KMS exports (we append SHA256 of daily logs to the ledger). That helps non-repudiation claims.

morgan: Great. I'll assemble everything into a 1-page PDF and share with legal + sales. Sasha, can you drop the RBAC CSV here when ready?

sasha: Dropping link when done — will ping. :white_check_mark: 

oncall: Quick vuln/triage note — there is a low-severity finding in the HSM shim (CVE-style) we discussed in last retro. We should mention mitigation (no exploitable path in our config) and timeline for patch.

morgan: Add that line as "known vulnerability status" with open ticket link and planned patch date.

priya: Filing follow-up: schedule tabletop with auditor + security leads next Tue 10am PT. I'll create the invite.

morgan: Thanks all — I'll post the draft here before sending externally.

sasha: SG, will follow up with CSV in ~2h.

diego: If anyone needs the export queries:```sql
-- KMS rewrap events last 24 months
SELECT time, actor, action, key_id, region, audit_id FROM kms_audit WHERE action IN ('rewrap','import','policy_change') AND time > now() - interval '24 months';
```

morgan: Perfect. Closing loop once docs uploaded.
